notes.title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! This release is Persona 4 Arena Ultimax, version 1.0.2. 
 
Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our hotfix release! This binary update rolls issues that were addressed in Beta 2 into the main branch. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made:  
 

Increased game stability to address an issue where certain graphic card drivers would cause the game to crash on the character select screen. 

 Improved game stability to reduce occurrence of drops in framerate 

 Adjusted overall game volume from user feedback. 

 Fixed an issue where the game crashes when playing on full screen with multiple monitors. Now if the monitor the game is being displayed on is removed during play of after the application is closed, it will not cause the game to crash. 

 Fixed an issue where certain sound effects would overlap each other to create unintended sounds. 

 Fixed an issue so that keyboard button configurations will not return to default every time the application is opened. 

 Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game pauses or not when not in focus. 

 Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game mutes or not when not in focus. 

 Added a volume control bar for the Movie scenes in Sound & Language Options. 

 Fixed an issue where the game would not display centered depending on monitor resolution.  

 
Thank you for playing! 
 
ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! This release is Persona 4 Arena Ultimax, version 1.0.1. 

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our hotfix release! This binary update rolls issues that were addressed in Beta 1 into the main branch. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made: 

Addressed an issue in which the game would crash when searching for online matches. 

Improved stability of the build which should reduce occurrence of "intrenderer" errors. 

Addressed an issue where the game would minimize itself on startup. 

Addressed an issue where usernames would display as blank during Rank Match searches. 

Additionally,  we recommend that players make sure their graphic drivers are updated to the latest versions, and to play in Windowed mode to further increase stability.  

Thank you for playing! 

ATLUS Comms

notes.title: P4AU Opt-In Beta 1 - IntRenderer Error Update
notes.notes:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players!

Thank you for reporting your issues with Persona 4 Arena Ultimax.

Our team has addressed an issue where users would receive an IntRenderer error upon launching the game, and have rolled a fix into the beta branch. This is an opt-in beta, so if you would like to opt in, please do the following:

From Persona 4 Arena Ultimax in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code:

p4auopenbeta1

From the drop down menu, select “open_beta_1-_”.

Issues addressed in this beta:

Improved stability of the build which should reduce occurrence of "intrenderer" errors.

Please post issues in this thread regarding this beta so that we can further identify technical issues. We appreciate your feedback and information you provided us.

ATLUS Comms
